headquarters: Road Town, Tortola, British Virgin Islands

mines.mine_notes: stream: stream equivalent to a 3% NSR on the original area of interest of the San Albino gold mine; Sailfish has the right to purchase 4% of all minerals produced at 25% of the LBMA p.m. gold price on the delivery date. Operator Mako Mining Corp. Commercial production achieved Jul 2021. FY2025: 61 oz Au and 17,661 oz Ag earned from streams (company total). ownership_pct shown is the stream rate; gold_oz/silver_oz are attributable stream ounces earned in 2025.

stream: on Apr 29, 2025 Sailfish exercised its option (consideration US$1M) to purchase all remaining silver production from Mako's San Albino mine and from concessions owned by Mako at Mar 1, 2023. Accounted for as a mineral property stream interest. Contributes to the San Albino stream ounces above.

silver purchase agreement with Mako (May 24, 2023): US$6M paid to acquire 13,500 oz/month of refined silver for a 24-month term (completed May 2025). FY2025: received and sold 67,500 oz of silver for proceeds of US$2,148,301 (2024: 160,067 oz for US$4,404,493). Silver receivable measured at FVTPL; balance US$nil at Dec 31, 2025. silver_oz shown is 2025 silver sold under this agreement.

royalty: 2% NSR on the district-scale land package surrounding the original San Albino area of interest, hosting high-grade targets including Las Conchitas and El Golfo. No value attributed in the FS. Exploration stage.

royalty: 1.5% NSR on El Compas, Zacatecas. Operator Grupo ROSGO, S.A. de C.V. (previously Endeavour Silver; sold to ROSGO Sep 12, 2022). Commissioning began 2018; commercial production Mar 2019; mining operations suspended during 2021 (care and maintenance). ownership_pct shown is the royalty rate.
royalty: 1% NSR on La Cigarra, Chihuahua. Operator Kootenay Silver Inc. Exploration stage. ownership_pct shown is the royalty rate.
royalty: 2.0% NSR on the Gavilanes property, Municipality of San Dimas, Durango. Operator Advance Metals Limited. Exploration stage. ownership_pct shown is the royalty rate.

SOLD POST-FY2025: portfolio of royalties on the Spring Valley gold project, Pershing County, Nevada (100% owned/controlled by Waterton Global Resource Management; acquired with Terraco Gold Corp.), ranging from 0.5% NSR on a portion up to a 3.0% sliding-scale NSR on the main portion (3.00% at gold price US$700+/oz). Fully permitted development project. On Feb 23, 2026 Sailfish agreed to sell Terraco Gold Corp. (holder of the Spring Valley and Moonlight royalties) to OR Royalties for US$168M after-tax cash; closed Apr 10, 2026. Carrying value of Spring Valley + Moonlight at Dec 31, 2025 was US$30,991,127. Listed here for continuity.

SOLD POST-FY2025: 2% NSR on the Moonlight exploration property north of the Spring Valley Project (95 private fee parcels + mineral leases + 230 unpatented lode claims). Acquired with Terraco Gold Corp.; no value attributed in the FS. Sold with Spring Valley to OR Royalties (closed Apr 10, 2026). Listed here for continuity.

POST-FY2025 (closed Mar 23, 2026): 11-year (132-month) gold stream from Mako, funded via a US$40M Wexford Capital senior secured bridge loan (Nov 26, 2025; SOFR+800bps; repaid Apr 13, 2026 with US$1.794M interest). Sailfish buys ~341.7 oz of gold per month for the first 60 months at 20% of the LBMA PM fix, floored at US$2,700/oz and capped at US$3,700/oz, then 100 oz/month for 72 months at 20% of the PM fix with no cap/floor. Secured against all present and after-acquired property of Mako plus pledges over the Mt. Hamilton Gold-Silver Project (Sailfish acquired Mt. Hamilton LLC on Sep 27, 2025 and transferred it to Mako for the stream). Post-year, 274.321 oz of gold sold for US$1,316,741 under the Gold Purchase Agreement. Facilitated by acquiring Mt. Hamilton LLC (assets held for sale at Dec 31, 2025).

notes: Precious-metals royalty/streaming company; fiscal year ended Dec 31, 2025, all amounts USD. Listed on TSX-V as FISH and OTCQB as SROYF. Incorporated Feb 27, 2014 under the BVI Business Companies Act; domiciled in the British Virgin Islands. Registered and head office: Sea Meadow House, P.O. Box 116, Road Town, Tortola, British Virgin Islands VG1110. FY2025: total revenue US$3,375,267 (royalty revenue US$2,366,144 + sales US$1,009,123; 2024: US$2,839,933); gross profit US$3,137,486; net income US$1,714,228. Royalty and stream interests carrying value US$35.5M at Dec 31, 2025 (no impairment indicators). No attributable GEOs disclosed (royaltyco); company-level gold/silver totals left null — 2025 attributable stream earnings were 61 oz Au + 17,661 oz Ag (San Albino streams) and 67,500 oz Ag sold under the Silver Purchase Agreement. Corporate: convertible debentures (US$4.1M, 10%) converted May 8, 2025 into 4,134,013 shares; 76,254,616 shares outstanding at Dec 31, 2025; quarterly dividend raised to US$0.0375/share from Q1 2026. Post-FY2025: Spring Valley + Moonlight royalties sold to OR Royalties for US$168M after-tax cash (closed Apr 10, 2026); new 11-year Mako gold stream closed Mar 23, 2026; US$40M Wexford bridge loan repaid in full Apr 13, 2026. Report: 2025 Audited Consolidated Financial Statements (PwC).
